title: Slowly, the Egg Walks
logline: In the Ethiopian highlands, a boastful rabbit challenges a slow tortoise to a race, naps halfway because he is sure he will win, and wakes to find the tortoise has already reached the finish.

audience.who: TODO(you): e.g. Amharic-speaking children aged 5-10 and their parents
audience.where: TODO(you): e.g. on a phone, vertical, YouTube Shorts / TikTok, sound on
audience.feel: TODO(you): e.g. laughing at the sleeping rabbit and cheering for the tortoise

style.block: cinematic nature documentary still, photorealistic animals with natural fur and shell detail, green Ethiopian highland landscape with acacia and warka trees, warm golden light, camera low at the animals' eye level, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, animals without clothes behaving naturally, main subject centred with the key action in the middle of a square frame, no text, no letters, no watermark
style.negative: cartoon, anime, 3d render, plastic look, clothes on animals, extra legs, deformed paws, two heads, text, watermark, harsh contrast, neon

characters.name: Tinchel (the rabbit)
characters.description: Tinchel, a slender Ethiopian highland hare (a wild rabbit): long upright ears with black tips, sandy-brown and grey fur flecked with black, a white belly and white chin, long powerful hind legs, large round amber eyes, long whiskers, a confident, cocky expression
characters.short: Tinchel the rabbit: slender Ethiopian highland hare, long black-tipped upright ears, sandy-brown and grey fur, white belly, long hind legs, large amber eyes

characters.name: Eli (the tortoise)
characters.description: Eli, an old leopard tortoise: a high domed shell patterned with cream and dark brown blotches, the edges of the shell worn smooth with age, thick wrinkled grey-brown scaly legs with short claws, a small wise face with calm dark eyes and a slightly hooked beak
characters.short: Eli the tortoise: old leopard tortoise, high domed shell with cream and dark brown blotches, wrinkled grey-brown legs, small wise face with calm dark eyes

voice.name: Kore
voice.style: Tell this like a warm grandparent telling a children's fable: clear, lively and kind, with gentle humour; a little proud and quick for the rabbit's words, slow and calm for the tortoise's.

shots.reason: Establishing shot: the place and, through the path and the far tree, the race course and its finish before we meet anyone.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot at sunrise over the green Ethiopian highlands: rolling hills, a winding red dirt path running from the foreground into the distance, a single huge old warka fig tree standing on the far hilltop where the path ends, flat-topped acacia trees, wildflowers, distant blue mountains under thin morning mist. No animals visible. Eye level, 24mm lens, deep focus

motion.video_prompt: slow cinematic pan to the right across the hills, mist drifts gently, grass sways, nothing else moves

narration.en: Long ago, in the green hills, there lived a rabbit who was very fast, and a tortoise who was very slow.
narration.spoken: ድሮ ድሮ፣ በአረንጓዴዎቹ ኮረብቶች ላይ በጣም ፈጣን ጥንቸልና በጣም ቀርፋፋ ኤሊ ይኖሩ ነበር።

shots.reason: Introduces the rabbit and his flaw, pride, in one image: high on the rock, looking down.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot. Tinchel the rabbit sits up tall on his hind legs on top of a flat grey rock beside the red dirt path, chest puffed out, ears straight up, looking down with a proud, mocking look; behind him the green hills in soft focus. Morning light from the side, 85mm lens, eye level with the rabbit

narration.en: The rabbit loved to laugh at the others. 'No one in these hills can beat me,' he said.
narration.spoken: ጥንቸሉ በሌሎች መሳቅ ይወድ ነበር። «በእነዚህ ኮረብቶች ውስጥ ማንም ሊያሸንፈኝ አይችልም» አለ።

shots.reason: Low angle on the tortoise answers the high angle on the rabbit: the small one accepts the challenge calmly.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of Eli the tortoise standing on the red dirt path at the foot of the rock, her head stretched out and tilted up toward the camera, calm dark eyes, a patient, quietly determined expression; low angle at ground level, grass blades in the soft foreground, warm morning light, 100mm macro lens

narration.en: The tortoise looked up and said quietly, 'Then let us race, to the big warka tree.'
narration.spoken: ኤሊዋ ቀና ብላ በለሆሳስ «እንግዲያው እስከ ትልቁ የዋርካ ዛፍ ድረስ እንሽቀዳደም» አለች።

shots.reason: The whole contrast of the film in one frame: one is already flying, the other has barely moved. Local animals as the crowd.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot at the start of the race on the red dirt path: a line of small white stones laid across the path as the start line; Tinchel the rabbit already leaping forward from the line in mid-sprint, all four paws off the ground, a puff of red dust behind him; Eli the tortoise just behind the line taking her first slow step. On both sides of the path, watching: a family of gelada monkeys sitting on rocks, a thick-billed raven and a few highland birds. Morning light, eye level, 35mm lens

narration.en: All the animals came to watch. The rabbit laughed. And the race began.
narration.spoken: እንስሳት ሁሉ ሊመለከቱ መጡ። ጥንቸሉ ሳቀ። ውድድሩም ተጀመረ።

shots.reason: Shows the distance between them, which is what makes the rabbit careless.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot. Tinchel the rabbit stands far along the red dirt path between acacia trees, glancing back over his shoulder with a smug look; far behind him, very small in the distance on the empty path, the tortoise is a tiny dark dot. Midday sun, heat haze over the path, 70mm lens, eye level with the rabbit

motion.video_prompt: the rabbit turns his head back over his shoulder, ears twitch, heat haze shimmers over the path, static camera

narration.en: In a moment, the rabbit was far ahead. He looked back, and the tortoise was only a small dot.
narration.spoken: ጥንቸሉ በቅጽበት በጣም ቀደመ። ወደ ኋላ ቢመለከት ኤሊዋ ትንሽ ነጥብ ብቻ ሆና ታየች።

shots.reason: The mistake: the rabbit stops because he underestimates the tortoise. The calm image makes the danger funny.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot. Tinchel the rabbit lies stretched out asleep on his side in the cool shade of a flat-topped acacia tree right beside the red dirt path, eyes shut, ears folded back along his body, relaxed and comfortable; dappled sunlight on the grass, a butterfly resting on a flower near his nose; the empty path continues behind him toward the far hilltop. Warm afternoon light, 50mm lens, low camera at ground level

narration.en: 'I have plenty of time,' he thought. He lay down in the shade beside the road, and fell asleep.
narration.spoken: «ብዙ ጊዜ አለኝ» ብሎ አሰበ። ከመንገዱ ዳር ጥላ ስር ተኝቶ እንቅልፍ ወሰደው።

shots.reason: The film's lesson shown, not told: steady steps. Close and low so the slow walk feels determined, not weak.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up at ground level of Eli the tortoise walking steadily along the red dirt path toward the camera: one front leg lifted mid-step, claws about to touch the dust, the other three legs planted firmly, head forward, eyes fixed on the road ahead; small footprints in the dust behind her; hot afternoon sun, heat haze, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field

narration.en: The tortoise did not stop. One step, then another, all through the hot afternoon.
narration.spoken: ኤሊዋ አላቆመችም። አንድ እርምጃ፣ ከዚያም ሌላ፣ በሞቃቱ ከሰዓት በኋላ ሁሉ።

shots.reason: The turning point: both characters in one frame as the lead changes hands.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot beside the acacia tree: in the foreground Tinchel the rabbit still lies asleep on his side in the shade, eyes shut; on the red dirt path just behind him, Eli the tortoise walks past in profile, steady and quiet, heading toward the far hilltop; both animals in sharp focus. Late afternoon golden light, long shadows, 35mm lens, low camera

narration.en: Slowly, quietly, she walked past the sleeping rabbit.
narration.spoken: ቀስ ብላ፣ በጸጥታ፣ ከተኛው ጥንቸል አጠገብ አልፋ ሄደች።

shots.reason: The payoff: the winner and the loser in one frame, so the audience sees the result before it is said.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot at the finish at sunset: the huge old warka fig tree on the hilltop with the red dirt path ending at its roots; Eli the tortoise has just arrived under the tree, while gelada monkeys and birds around her cheer; far down the path behind her, Tinchel the rabbit sprints uphill in panic, ears flat back, a trail of red dust, too late. Orange sunset light, long shadows, 28mm lens, eye level

motion.video_prompt: the rabbit sprints uphill far in the background kicking up dust, the monkeys bounce and wave, leaves stir, static camera

narration.en: When the rabbit woke up, he ran as fast as he could. But the tortoise was already at the tree.
narration.spoken: ጥንቸሉ ሲነቃ የቻለውን ያህል ሮጠ። ኤሊዋ ግን ቀድማ ዛፉ ጋ ደርሳ ነበር።

shots.reason: Resolution: the proud one is humbled, and the Amharic proverb gives the moral a local voice.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up under the warka tree at dusk: Eli the tortoise rests calmly among the big tree roots, a few small yellow meskel daisies beside her; Tinchel the rabbit sits in front of her, out of breath, ears drooping, head lowered, humble; the two face each other. Soft warm dusk light, 50mm lens, low camera at the animals' eye level

narration.en: Slow and steady wins the race. As the elders say: little by little, even an egg learns to walk.
narration.spoken: ቀስ ብሎ የማያቋርጥ ያሸንፋል። አበው እንዳሉት፦ ቀስ በቀስ እንቁላል በእግሩ ይሄዳል።

music.caption: playful Ethiopian-inspired instrumental for a children's fable, plucked krar, masenqo fiddle, light kebero hand drum, bright pentatonic melody, gentle comic pizzicato, a drowsy lullaby passage, building to a warm triumphant ending, acoustic, instrumental

cues.intent: open softly, morning in the hills
quick playful race theme as the rabbit sprints
slow drowsy lullaby while the rabbit sleeps
tiptoe pizzicato as the tortoise passes
build and lift to a warm triumphant finish, resolve into the end card

credits: A retelling of Aesop's fable The Tortoise and the Hare
